sections.heading: I build the systems that keep institutions running.
sections.body:
An operations and management professional based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, focused on building efficient systems, strengthening institutional operations, and turning strategic objectives into measurable outcomes.

My work spans operations and administration, procurement and supply chain management, project coordination, financial oversight, and people management. I believe sustainable institutions are built through effective leadership, structured processes, accountable teams, and continuous improvement.

Building systems. Strengthening operations. Enabling growth.

sections.heading: Projects and case studies
sections.body: Five pieces of work from Imam Bukhari Trust. Each one sets out the challenge, my role, what I did, the result and the skills it called on.

sections.items:
Infrastructure | Mosque and academic building | IBT is building a seven-storey mosque and an eleven-storey academic building, with several contractors, engineers and suppliers involved at once. | Coordinate the project on the operations side and report progress to management. | Coordinate contractors, engineers and suppliers, keep track of the timeline and costs, follow up on site work, and arrange site services such as separate three-phase power connections for each building. | Since piling began in 2024, management has had one clear view of progress and spending, and the first floor of the mosque has been completed. | Project coordination, Contractor management, Cost tracking, Stakeholder management, Risk management
Procurement | Procurement and supply chain system | Purchases and service contracts needed a written, repeatable procedure that the management committee could review and trust. | Wrote the procurement SOP and run the full purchasing cycle. | Set out the steps for RFQs, vendor evaluation, comparative statements, purchase orders, approvals and delivery follow-up, and introduced total-cost-of-ownership analysis for high-value purchases, including a three-firm comparison to select the external auditor. | Ad-hoc buying was replaced by a documented procedure, and each buying decision now reaches the committee with a comparative statement behind it. | Procurement management, Vendor evaluation, Total cost of ownership, Policy development, Financial compliance
Digital systems | Digital operations and management systems | Income, expenses, KPIs, stock, attendance and staff tasks sat in separate files and paper registers, and monthly reports were put together by hand. | Designed and built the systems, wrote the user guides, and lead the move to an ERP. | Built the Trust's first digital income, expense, KPI and inventory systems; merged income and expense into one entry sheet with automatic monthly Receipts and Payments reports; added an attendance and leave system that follows the HR policy and a live task dashboard; and started an ERP covering finance, HR, procurement, inventory and donors. | Fewer manual errors and faster monthly reporting, with each area tracked in one place. | Process design, Google Sheets and Apps Script, Dashboards, ERP planning, Change management
Programmes | Programmes, training and events | Courses, workshops, special programmes and a weekly halaqa bring thousands of people together each year, in person and online, and every one needs a plan that staff and volunteers can follow. | Coordinate them with programme managers, scholars, staff and volunteers. | Built plans and volunteer maps, assigned roles across IBT staff, partner institutions and volunteers, managed logistics on the day, and designed and delivered staff training on professional ethics, team building, and task, time and SMART planning. | 140 programmes and sessions since Nov 2023 with 14,000+ recorded attendances, including family get-togethers of 432 (2025) and 605 (2026) and a day-long dawah skills training for 100+ participants. | Programme management, Event operations, Volunteer management, Training design and delivery
Institutional development | Fundraising and institutional development | A growing trust needed steady donor income, clear governance and strong links with partner institutions. | Supervise fundraising and support the Management Committee on governance and planning. | Supervised fundraising campaigns and donor follow-up, recorded and acknowledged donations across mobile and bank channels, prepared committee reports, and worked on policy reform and the revision of the Trust's constitution. | 32 fundraising campaigns supervised and 70 of 90 residential units sold, with committee decisions backed by regular reports. | Fundraising, Donor relations, Governance and reporting, Policy development, Stakeholder engagement

sections.heading: Professional profile
sections.body:
I am an operations and administration professional with 4+ years of experience, an engineering background and an MBA in Supply Chain Management. My work spans institutional administration, procurement, project coordination, financial controls, people management and organisational systems development.

As Manager, Administration and Operations at Imam Bukhari Trust, I work across these functions to strengthen operational efficiency, improve internal processes and support strategic execution. I lead a team of 8 to 10 and report to the Management Committee.

I am most interested in building scalable management systems, improving institutional governance and using technology to make organisations more accountable, efficient and sustainable. Alongside this, I co-author research on Islamic education and keep studying the Islamic sciences and Arabic.
